This Functional Requirements Specification (FRS) documents the functional requirements for the State Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme, which aims to transition the administration of the scheme from a paper-based process to a fully online platform, ensuring that eligible students receive their scholarships in a transparent and time-bound manner [GO-2]. The directing Government Order is [GO-2], which mandates that all applications under the scheme, both fresh and renewal, shall be received, verified, sanctioned, and paid online from the academic year 2026-27. This FRS incorporates the corrigendum [COR1-1], which updates the annual family income limit for eligibility to Rs. 3,00,000 per annum, and acknowledges that all other conditions of the Government Order remain unchanged [COR1-2]. The intended readers of this FRS include the District Social Welfare Officers, institution nodal officers, the Principal Secretary of the Social Welfare Department, and the developers and administrators responsible for building and maintaining the scholarship portal and associated systems.

The scope of this FRS covers the complete end-to-end online workflow for the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme, including application submission, Aadhaar-based e-KYC, document verification, sanctioning, rejection, payment processing, grievance redressal, and system reporting [GO-3.1], [GO-3.3], [GO-4.1], [GO-4.2], [GO-5.1], [GO-6.1]. It encompasses the integration with Common Service Centres (CSCs) for assisted applications, the utilization of DigiLocker for certificates, and the Direct Benefit Transfer of funds via PFMS to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts [GO-4.3], [GO-4.1], [GO-6.1]. Furthermore, the FRS specifies the technical requirements for the portal, including its availability in Hindi and English, compatibility with low-end Android phones on 3G connections, and the provision of a dedicated mobile application for students [MIN-3], [MIN-5], [VB-1]. The document also addresses data retention, audit trails, and the handling of payment failures and appeals, thereby establishing the comprehensive framework for the scheme's digital transformation [ASM-6], [ASM-7], [ANS-1], [ANS-2].
